about: #4724: what each translate-only refusal or hole of the det translator is, for the support matrix (tests/tools/support_matrix.py). A text is a burned evidence report's translation `refused` or one of its `holes` (cics_census.py survey); a missing copybook of the feature inventory reads as `missing copybook NAME`. Exactly one entry's `match` (a regex, searched) must hit each text: tests/cobol_mainframe/test_support_matrix.py checks every one in the committed reports.

An entry carries at least one of: `issue` (the issue that owns the gap), `charter` (an agreed refusal family of definition_of_done.md, keyed in `charter` below), `system_library` (a COPY member of the customer's own IBM product libraries: a configuration fix, not a translator limit, #4724 design point 2). An entry with none -- or whose `api` has no issue -- is `needs an issue`: the matrix flags it as an acceptance gap of #4724 and test_support_matrix.py fails. `api` names a runtime API the program calls that is not modelled: a program that reaches it translates but cannot be proven (design point 3). `features` are the inventory features (`category: key`) the refusal is about.

charter.not-cobol: a file that is not COBOL
charter.missing-copy: COPY members not in the estate
charter.ibm-undefined: CICS and Db2 options IBM leaves undefined
charter.cobol-unmodelled: COBOL features the det port does not model

api.name: IBM MQ (MQI: MQOPEN / MQGET / MQPUT / MQCLOSE)

entries.note: IBM MQ copybooks not found: point the scanner at SCSQCOBC. The det translator ships GitGalaxy-written stand-ins with the MQ model behind them (register W1): MQOPEN / MQGET / MQPUT / MQPUT1 / MQCLOSE from a CICS program translate and are provable (#4892); any other MQI call, batch MQ and an MQ constant the stand-in CMQV does not declare stay refused (register W6). The inventory's `call_targets` category (#5565) names every CALLed program, so an unmodelled API is seen without its copybook; the matrix does not yet join `call_targets` features to entries (keyed in `features` once `test_refusal_map_entries_are_well_formed` allows the category).
LE copybooks not found: point the scanner at SCEESAMP. CEEIGZCT has a stand-in (register L4, #4884) used only where the estate's library lacks it.
A COPY member the estate does not ship (not an IBM product library member).
A program written to CICS's pre-command-level macro API (DFHPC / DFHFC / DFHTC / DFHSC ... TYPE= calls, CSA / TCA addressing; era 0, #5121, register X55): named and refused, never translated.
An assembler program written for CICS (DFHEIENT / DFHEISTG / EXEC CICS in HLASM, or macro level; #5121, register X55): the translator reads COBOL only; named and refused.

entries.match: is not defined in a record of file
entries.note: IBM: a key item is in the file's own record; the oracle does not compile the program as written.

entries.match: \bALTER (not modelled|\S+: the paragraph is not a lone GO TO)
entries.note: ALTER is modelled (#5560, register C19): the altered GO TO reads a per-paragraph slot in the paragraph dispatcher. What stays a named hole is an ALTER of a paragraph that is not a lone GO TO without DEPENDING (IBM refuses it too), an undeclared paragraph, and an independent segment. `ALTER not modelled` is the text of reports made before #5568; no burned estate carries the other forms.
IBM's run-time routine is not documented bit for bit (register C6).
Db2's message text is not modelled (register Q5).

entries.match: SET ADDRESS OF|NULL: pointers are not modelled|WEB RECEIVE SET: option not modelled
EXEC CICS (?:STARTBROWSE CONTAINER|GETNEXT|ENDBROWSE CONTAINER) not modelled

entries.note: Modelled since #5090; a report surveyed before it still shows the refusal until the evidence refresh.
LE date/time callable services; the runtime models them since #4949's slice (catalogue family LE), a report surveyed before it still shows the hole.

api.name: LE condition handling (CEEHDLR / CEEHDLU, CEEMGET, CEESGL, CEENCOD, CEEMRCE, CEE3SRP)

entries.note: Registering (CEEHDLR) or unregistering (CEEHDLU) an LE user condition handler: refused by name in dyncall.REFUSED_BY_NAME, three pieces are missing before a registration can be proven: the procedure pointer it takes (SET TO ENTRY, `procedure-pointer`), LE's dispatch of a raised condition to the handler (CEESGL, CEENCOD, CEEMRCE, CEE3SRP) and the handler's RESUME / PERCOLATE result (#5106; DBB epscsmrd REGISTER-EXCEPTION-HANDLER, the only burned user). The handler program (EPSCSMRF) translated on its own holds two holes, `SET ADDRESS OF ... TO TOKEN` (`pointers`, #5042) and CEEMGET (this entry); its `SET RESUME TO TRUE` translates. The old report text is `CALL CALL CEEHDLR`, the refusal reads `CALL CEEHDLR: ...`: both match.

entries.match: ^CALL CALL EPSCSMR[A-Z]$|^CALL [A-Z0-9#@$-]+: a sibling program of this source
entries.note: A CALL to a sibling program of the same multi-program source (DBB epscsmrd.cbl's EPSCSMRI / EPSCSMRO / EPSCSMRX): resolved since #5106 to a service of its own (static and dynamic CALL; OMITTED, RETURNING, group and BY CONTENT USING items). What stays refused is a sibling that cannot be translated: its CALL reads `X: no service of its own, its translation is refused: <the sibling's reason>` and maps to the entry owning that reason (EPSCSMRI: national text; EPSCSMRO: le-recovery-point), not here. This entry holds only a CALL refused for the sibling's contract (BY VALUE, a unit that CALLs back, a CICS unit, a USING shape the entry does not take) and the old report text `CALL CALL EPSCSMRX`. Engine side: #4447, #4404.

CALL MVSWAIT (CardDemo COBSWAIT): modelled since #5106 (det LIBRARY entry, Mvswait.java, tests/equivalence/le/mvswait.c; returns at once, RETURN-CODE 0, storage untouched; register A1). The report lines move once the program is translated; COBSWAIT is proven on the det port with the job's own SYSIN card since #5106 (case carddemo-cobswait; the oracle feeds both sides the case's sysin; the proof shows the run completes with RETURN-CODE 0 and no output, the MOVE of the card into the COMP item is not observed).

ACCEPT FROM SYSIN (a batch input stream): modelled by the det runtime (Accept.sysin, one stdin record per ACCEPT, no record left refused by name); the oracle feeds both sides the case's `sysin` stream (equivalence.py, equivalence_java.py), so COBSWAIT is provable (carddemo-cobswait). The oracle is GnuCOBOL: IBM leaves the target undefined with no record left, and the runtime refuses by name.

entries.match: SET TO ENTRY: procedure / function pointers
entries.note: Procedure / function pointers: no model (#5042 is the data-pointer lane). The only burned user is DBB epscsmrd `SET ROUTINE TO ENTRY 'EPSCSMRF'`, whose pointer is only ever passed to CEEHDLR / CEEHDLU: it is proven together with `le-condition-handling` (LE dispatch, RESUME / PERCOLATE), never alone, so no pointer model is added before that one.

entries.match: ^SET-(?:POINTER|ADDRESS) ADDRESS OF \S+: (?:not a LINKAGE 01 record|a subordinate item)
entries.note: SET ptr TO ADDRESS OF rec / SET ADDRESS OF rec TO ...: only a LINKAGE 01 record has storage a pointer can address (det/gen.py address_record). A WORKING-STORAGE record (DBB epscsmrd's ERROR-RESPONSE, handed to the LE handler as TOKEN) or a subordinate item (an offset into its record) is refused by name; the sole consumer in the burned estates is the CEEHDLR handler token, which is itself refused (#5106).

EXEC CICS GETMAIN without INITIMG: IBM gives acquired storage no default contents, so a zero-filled block would be an invented fact; refused by name (storage.py, register X47). DBB epscsmrd's ALLOCATE-DFH-BODY-WORK-AREA / ALLOCATE-DFH-DATA-WORK-AREA are the only burned users (#5106).

SERVICE LABEL after CALL 'CEE3SRP' (an LE recovery point: where control resumes after a condition is handled; DBB epscsmrd's EPSCSMRO, generated converter code in an Enterprise COBOL program with no BLL cells). Refused whole by name in det/bll.py; it needs LE's condition dispatch (le-condition-handling) before it can be modelled. Until #5119 it was reported as an OS/VS COBOL BLL refusal.

OS/VS COBOL's BLL cells and SERVICE RELOAD (era 1) are lowered onto the pointer lane by IBM's conversion to VS COBOL II, chained storage areas included (register X56); an idiom the lowering cannot keep exactly is refused whole by name.

CICS web services (SOAP / WS-Addressing): no model (WEB #4767 and DOCUMENT #4769 are the HTTP side). Refused by name, register X65, every SOAPFAULT CREATE option refused whole. The only burned user is DBB epscsmrd SEND-SOAP-FAULT (`SOAPFAULT CREATE CLIENT FAULTSTRING FAULTSTRLEN`, a web-service reply to the client); no cics-crucible event kind carries a fault, and epscsmrd stays held by the other boxes, so a model would prove no program.

entries.match: a property the port cannot convert
entries.note: A COMMAREA DTO property the CICS port cannot map to bytes. An elementary item's own OCCURS (a List<T> of String / Integer / Long / Short / BigDecimal) is modelled since #5565 (#5567; occurrence i at offset + i * width): CardDemo's COPAUS0C / COPAUS1C PAUKEY-PREV-PG and AUTH-KEYS no longer hit this (the published evidence report shows both with 0 holes, COPAUS0C 370/370, COPAUS1C 193/193). What is left refused: a List of another type, a table whose bytes are not n equal items, and a PIC the DTO comment does not carry.

entries.match: no repository for this file in the generated project
entries.note: A file with no store in the generated project (catalogue RT-FILE-UNBOUND-FILE, REFUSED). #5034 (closed) bound a CALLed subprogram's DDs in its caller's step; these programs' files are not that case. Refused by name, not modelled: no burned estate hits it now. The two programs that carried it in the committed evidence fixtures (CardDemo CBSTM03B: CLOSE / OPEN / READ TRNX-FILE; CBSA BANKDATA: CLOSE / OPEN / WRITE CUSTOMER-FILE, with CEEGMT / CEEDATM beside them) are, in the published evidence reports, translated whole with 0 holes (CBSTM03B 3 holes -> 0, BANKDATA 6 -> 0): each file's DD reaches a repository through its caller's step (#5068) or the estate's DD / dataset binding. A file that really has no store stays an OPEN / CLOSE-only handle (DetFiles.Unbound; a record operation on it is a hole), so a program of a non-burned estate is out of scope here (burned-only policy).
